question: What was Dell Technologies' revenue from AI-optimized servers in the second quarter of fiscal 2027 (the quarter ended July 31, 2026)? Answer in USD millions.
grading: ±0.5%, USD millions (accept $16.4B). Period must be Q2 FY2027 (three months ended 2026-07-31). Fail if orders, backlog, six-month (32,533) or ISG total (31,782) is given as the answer.
answer: AI-optimized servers revenue was USD 16,401 million in Q2 FY2027 (three months ended July 31, 2026), up 100% from USD 8,208 million a year earlier. It sits within ISG revenue of USD 31,782 million; total Dell net revenue was USD 46,971 million. [T03-E1, T03-E2]
